# SimplyTrip

> > SimplyTrip is India's online vehicle rental platform offering tempo travellers, buses, and minibuses for group and corporate travel across major cities.

SimplyTrip Mobility Solutions provides comprehensive fleet options including Force Tempo Travellers (9-26 seater), luxury buses from Volvo, Mercedes-Benz, Scania, and BharatBenz across Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Pune, Gurgaon, and Hyderabad. The platform specializes in per-km pricing for outstation trips, corporate employee shuttles, and group transportation with professional drivers.

## Key Topics

- Tempo Traveller Rental
- Bus Rental & Minibus Hire
- Group Travel & Transportation
- Corporate Employee Shuttles
- Per-km Pricing Models
- Outstation & Intercity Trips
- Volvo & Mercedes-Benz Fleet
- Force Tempo Traveller (12-26 seater)
- BharatBenz & Scania Buses
- Delhi NCR & Mumbai Operations
- Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad Services
- Wedding & Event Transportation
- Vehicle Booking Platform
- AC Pushback Seating
- Professional Driver Services
